name: University of Manchester

facts.text: The University of Manchester was founded in 1824 and its campus is on Oxford Road, Manchester, M13 9PL.
Manchester is part of the Russell Group, with more than 44,000 students, 12,000 staff and 550,000 alumni from 190 countries.
Manchester is home to 26 Nobel Prize winners and is known for the world's first nuclear reaction, building the modern computer and isolating graphene.
Manchester is ranked 6th in the UK and 51st in the world in the Academic Ranking of World Universities (2026), and fifth for research power in REF 2021.
Manchester was the most popular UK university for undergraduate applications (UCAS 2023 cycle) and the second most targeted university by the UK's leading employers (The Graduate Market, 2024).

However, UKVI may arrange interviews in other ways, including by telephone, depending on the circumstances.' 'For most applicants, the interview usually lasts 5-10 minutes.' No university-run pre-CAS interview, CAS Shield or Enroly mentioned.
